combined_library: TRI_GA is the exact audited union of the three completed route libraries, not a fourth search algorithm.
mpg_start_population: Use all 8000 saved formal upstream R designs for the same case and run after their explicit mathematical projection. Do not condition on saved feasibility and do not use observed recipe values.
mpg_representative: For each start with at least one audited feasible step-zero or accepted visit, retain the visit with maximum frozen task Q; ties retain the earliest visit.
mpg_output_record: Save per-start visit counts, best representative identity, Q, prediction, margin, step and generating continuous objective; rejected line-search trials are not candidate outputs.

downstream_fairness.seed_selector: within each successful structure, Q at or above the within-pool median; choose best Q first, then farthest normalized composition with Q tie-break
downstream_fairness.GA_parameters: identical to the frozen Generator-GA and R-GA protocol
downstream_fairness.lineages: each selected seed is optimized independently without cross-lineage mixing

evaluation.shared_replay: float64 frozen RBF evaluator, explicit structural constraints and native lattice
evaluation.fixed_selection: case-specific frozen cap, within-support median-Q floor, best-Q then farthest-point order
evaluation.screening: nominal Q>=0.75 and standardized margin>=0.05; sensitivity additionally requires frozen 200-bootstrap joint-window frequency>=0.80
evaluation.aggregation: five complete runs; report candidate-weighted and support-equal summaries; candidates are not independent replicates

prohibitions: no observed numeric recipe as a start or repair anchor
no overwrite of V35 or historical formal results
no equal-wall-clock claim from equal GA-attempt budgets
